verdict.rationale: Brex's authentication docs say admins can create named API tokens in the dashboard and choose the level of data access as scopes. That is a first-party mechanism for issuing least-privilege credentials an agent can use, and Brex also documents an official MCP server for AI assistants. Missing for 10: detail on scope granularity, token expiry and revocation, any agent-specific credential guidance linking scoped tokens to the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
